notes.title: New season and rebalancing! Update 1.32

tags.balance_change: - Rebalancing of receiving points (now there are fewer of them);

tags.feature: - The second season is launched: the table of records has been updated;

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug due to which the combo was reset when changing music;

notes.title: Update 1.3

tags.feature: - It is now possible to control the ship on the stick, not just on the d-pad (gamepad);

tags.balance_change: - Changes in balance. The game has become easier at all levels of difficulty;

tags.bug: - Improved support for gamepads (previously there were problems if more than one gamepad is connected to PC);

tags.feature: - Added message about possibility to upload your tracks to the game folder.
